observations: Three manual hydraulic pallet jacks are shown outdoors on a concrete floor.
The jacks have yellow painted metal forks and black handles.
The hydraulic rams and wheels are visible.
The photo contains a watermark 'PREYE DOUGLAS77'.
The photo is taken in a cluttered yard with other equipment in the background.

claims.evidence: The photo shows the item but cannot confirm its weight capacity or structural integrity.
No capacity plate or label is visible in the photo to confirm the tonnage.
The design with hand-operated levers and no power source confirms this.
The forks and handle design are characteristic of a pallet jack.

risks.risk: The hydraulic ram may be leaking fluid or the pump may be seized.
risks.proof: A video showing the jack being raised and lowered with a load.
risks.if_unproven: as having a non-functional hydraulic system

risks.risk: The forks may be cracked, bent, or have deep surface rust.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the fork tines and the underside of the forks.

risks.risk: The wheels may be flat or the bearings may be seized.
risks.proof: A video showing the wheels rolling freely.

proof_requests: Close-up photos of any label, plate or sticker showing the brand and weight capacity.
A video showing the hydraulic pump being operated and the forks being raised and lowered.
Close-up photos of the fork tines and the underside of the forks to check for cracks or rust.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
